description:
After realizing we’re still a few years too young to pilot an actual NASA spacecraft, we figured the next best thing was building the mission ourselves. Armed with late-night brainstorming, an obsession with video games, and endless creativity, we’re ready to take over the galaxy—one level at a time. 

We are four Grade 9 girls from Sama American Private School in Sharjah, UAE. We will be combining art, gaming, and space to build an epic mission game (and prove we can run Mission Control).
summary:
Beyond Earth is an interactive space mission simulation game that puts players in the role of mission controllers, challenging them to make important decisions and navigate the unpredictable challenges of space exploration.

The game features interactive missions, scoring systems, challenges, and multiple possible outcomes based on players' decisions. It also incorporates historical space facts, connecting real-world space exploration with an engaging gaming experience.

Our goal is to make learning about space exploration more exciting and accessible while developing players' critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. By combining educational content with interactive gameplay, Chaos Control transforms the experience of space exploration into an exciting mission where every decision matters.
details:
Beyond Earth is an interactive space mission simulation designed to introduce players to the challenges of space exploration through mission-based gameplay.

Players take on the role of mission controllers and complete interactive missions by making decisions, responding to unexpected challenges, and managing different situations. The game includes a scoring system that evaluates players' decisions, as well as multiple possible outcomes depending on the choices they make.

The project also incorporates historical space facts, allowing players to connect the simulated missions with real-world space exploration. Its main purpose is to make learning about space more engaging while encouraging critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making.

We developed the project using Google AI Studio and Gemini Omni, which assisted in creating the game's code and interactive experience.

The creative aspect of Beyond Earth is its combination of education and simulation. Rather than simply reading about space missions, players actively participate in simulated situations and experience how their decisions can influence mission outcomes. This makes space exploration more interactive, accessible, and exciting.
